competency_fulfillment.rationale: Every stem recites both addends broken into hundreds, tens and ones before asking for the total, and I verified each key computes correctly. The difficulty is that the decomposition is done for the learner: the instruction to add the place values, then find the total can be ignored entirely and the numerals added directly, so the expanded-form method is never actually required or produced.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Pairs needing no carry and pairs needing a carry in more than one column are both generated, and three-digit-plus-two-digit pairs appear alongside three-digit-plus-three-digit ones. The expanded phrasing also handles singular and plural units correctly, which matters when an addend contributes exactly one one.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The stems are long by Quarter 1 standards, since a single item can recite six place-value phrases before the question arrives. An item stating that 156 is 1 hundred, 5 tens, and 6 ones and then doing the same for the second addend puts a substantial reading load in front of a computation a second grader would otherwise handle comfortably.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Four response types appear, but every one of them is poured into the same recitation frame, so the surface of the item never changes. There is no problem situation, no vertical arrangement, and crucially no item asking for the sum expressed back in expanded form, which is the orientation this competency most obviously supports.

competency_alignment.rationale: The axis being varied is whether and where regrouping occurs, together with whether both addends carry a hundreds part, and both of those are the genuine difficulty drivers for expanded-form addition. The progression does not drift onto an unrelated dimension.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Sums run from the mid-four-hundreds up to exactly one thousand and none exceeds the stated bound. The pair summing to 1000 is used as the basis of a false statement rather than as a produced total, so the ceiling is tested at its edge without being breached.
